verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships a built-in 'AI SRE' agent that investigates incidents, answers natural-language queries about logs/charts, drafts post-mortems, opens GitHub PRs and Linear tickets, and can be invoked directly from Slack/Teams by tagging @betterstack — this is a genuine in-product AI assistant users can delegate SRE tasks to, not just an external MCP integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI SRE's actual task outcomes and reliability, since all evidence is vendor-authored marketing/docs.
